key_metric: FY27 guidance revision read jointly with product gross margin. Street FY27 consensus ($9.02 EPS / $7.54B rev) already sits at the top of company guidance ($8.70-9.00 / $7.325-7.575B), so a reiterate is a de facto cut. Management pre-announced the July quarter as the product-GM trough (56.1% in Q4) amid NAND/DRAM inflation; the tell is whether the 68.5-69.5% FY27 GM range is raised, held, or cut.
